content: It is worth noting that our Transformer encoder is different from the original one in the position embedding part. Position embedding, as an important component in Transformers and BERT, is used to encode the position and order information of each token in a sequence. However, one big difference between language sentences and EHR sequences is that the medical codes within the same visit do not generally have an order, so we remove the position embedding in our model.
